# NexaFlow

> NexaFlow is an AI-powered operations platform connecting teams, data, and workflows so modern organizations can move faster with less friction.

## Core Capabilities
- **Workflow Automation**: Build repeatable workflows with intelligent triggers, conditions, and actions without rebuilding legacy tech stacks.
- **Intelligent Insights**: Convert real-time operational data into clear, actionable dashboards.
- **Unified Source of Truth**: Eliminate manual data handoffs and fragmented tools across engineering, product, and operations teams.

## Platform Sections & Architecture
- **Hero**: AI-Powered operations overview featuring dynamic stats (128 active workflows, 42% time saved, 3.8k tasks automated) and live weekly activity monitoring.
- **Trusted By**: Trusted by modern enterprise teams including Vertex, Northstar, Axiom, Motion, and Lumen.
- **Why NexaFlow**: Three-pillar foundation:
  1. *Connect your tools*: Seamless integration with existing tech stacks.
  2. *Automate repetitive work*: Replace manual handoffs with automated intelligence.
  3. *Measure what matters*: Centralized operational metrics and bottleneck identification.
- **The Platform**: Modular workflow orchestration engine and real-time efficiency dashboards (+28% efficiency boost).
- **Customer Story**: Verified case study with Northstar COO Sarah Chen demonstrating a 41% reduction in manual processes.
- **Call to Action**: Direct scheduling for customized live product demonstrations.

## Technical Specifications
- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn UI components, semantic theme variables
- **Motion**: Framer Motion with hardware-accelerated spring physics and directional micro-interactions
- **API & Configuration**: Centralized type-safe content management via `config.ts` and `animation-config.ts`
